Enum Class KeyCode

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Enum<KeyCode>
dev.tamboui.tui.event.KeyCode
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable, Comparable<KeyCode>, Constable
public enum KeyCode extends Enum<KeyCode>
Represents keyboard key codes for special keys.

Regular printable characters use CHAR and the character can be retrieved from KeyEvent.character().
